title: POST /msg/sent also deliver()s to public inbox
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/messaging.py

Correctness/security: SentMessagesResource.render_post (line 326) gates on _peer_is_local_admin then calls MessagesResource.render_post. That path always writes _sent AND self.deliver(body), which appends the outbound body to _inbox and fires ObservableResource.updated_state (and legacy /messages aliases).

Firmware lichen_msg_sent_post (coap_msg.c:373) only queues via lichen_msg_send into s_sent. It does not call lichen_msg_receive / touch the inbox. Spec 18.11 lists /msg/sent as GET; LCI vectors msg_sent_local_admin / msg_sent_mesh_forbidden treat POST /msg/sent as the sent mailbox, not receive.

GET /msg/inbox is public (test_msg_inbox_get_is_public). So an LCI admin POST /msg/sent copies the outbound body into a mesh-observable inbox. Mesh observers of /msg/inbox see private sends. Inbox unread_count also increases for messages this node sent.

Do not conflate with inbox POST, which spec 18.1.2 and the MessagesResource docstring intentionally deliver to inbox.
acceptance_criteria: POST /msg/sent from loopback/admin returns 2.01 and stores the record in sent/_sent_order/detail only. _inbox, unread_count, and Observe notifications on /msg/inbox and /messages MUST NOT change. Firmware lichen_msg_sent_post / lichen_msg_send remain the contract. POST /msg/inbox still delivers to inbox.
